tools.name: batch-call
tools.title: Run a batch of MCP tool calls
tools.description: Supports stop or continue error policy, execution resumption, and deferred save, refresh, or builder finalization for mutation-heavy batches.

calls.description: Ordered tool calls. Each item uses {tool, arguments?, id?}; ids can be referenced later in the batch.

id.description: Optional local id. Later calls can reference it through $ref substitutions.

tool.description: MCP tool name, for example project-list or databaseobject-tree-get.

arguments.description: Arguments object sent to the target tool.

onError.description: Allowed values: stop or continue. stop aborts on the first failure; continue records failures and keeps running.

resumeFrom.description: Zero-based call index to resume from after a previous partial run.

executionId.description: Opaque execution id returned by a previous batch run.

optimizeMutations.description: Default true. Defers refresh, save, and mobile-builder finalization until the batch ends.

tools.name: databaseobject-delete
tools.title: Delete a database object
tools.description: Removes an existing object from the project tree. Use autoSave=false or batch-call when you want to group several mutations before exporting.

autoSave.description: Set false to keep the deletion in memory and skip project export.

refresh.description: Set false to skip Studio tree refresh.

tools.name: databaseobject-move
tools.title: Move or reorder a database object
tools.description: Moves an existing object under a new parent or repositions it before or after a sibling. Source and target QNames must already exist.

target.description: Existing target QName. Container when position=inside; sibling anchor when position=before or after.

position.description: Allowed values: inside, before, after. inside moves under the target; before or after reorders next to it.

autoSave.description: Set false to keep the move in memory and skip project export.

refresh.description: Set false to skip Studio tree refresh.

tools.name: databaseobject-rename
tools.title: Rename a database object
tools.description: Renames an existing object and can refactor references. Use update_all only when cross-project refactoring is intended.

name.description: New object name. Use a valid Convertigo identifier for the target class.

update.description: Allowed values: update_none, update_local, update_all. Controls how references are rewritten after the rename.

autoSave.description: Set false to keep the rename in memory and skip project export.

refresh.description: Set false to skip Studio tree refresh.

tools.name: databaseobject-schema
tools.title: Read a database object schema or sample
tools.description: Returns XML, JSON, or JSON Schema for an existing object. For requestables, internal=true switches from the response schema to the request schema.

type.description: Allowed values: xml, json, jsonschema. Default: xml.

internal.description: Set true to read the request schema of a requestable instead of its response schema.

tools.name: databaseobject-search
tools.title: Search database objects
tools.description: Searches names, comments, and QNames under one root or across all projects. Supports cursor pagination and optional regex matching.

qname.description: Optional root QName. Omit to search across all loaded projects.

filter.description: Search text. Space-separated terms are combined; pair with useRegExp=true for a regex.

limit.description: Maximum matches returned per call. 1 to 1000; default 200.

useRegExp.description: Set true to treat filter as a Java regular expression.

objectType.description: Optional object type filter. Use * or omit for any type.

tools.name: databaseobject-tree-apply
tools.title: Patch a canonical database object tree
tools.description: Creates or updates canonical tree nodes relative to an existing target. Prefer merge for incremental edits; use replace only when missing children should be pruned in the patched scope.

target.description: Existing QName. Case-sensitive. Patched when at=self; used as the anchor when at=inside, before, or after.

at.description: Allowed values: self, inside, before, after. self patches the target; the others place the input tree relative to it.

mode.description: Allowed values: merge or replace. replace also removes children missing from the patched scope.

id.description: Optional local id for $ref substitutions inside the submitted tree.

name.description: Object name when creating or matching a child.

className.description: Object class token. For NGX dynamic entries, keep the logical form such as ngx.components.UIDynamicElement#Button.

properties.description: Property updates as either a simple name/value map or an array of property entries from tree-get.

name.description: Property name as returned by tree-get.

value.description: Property value. Keep the same shape returned by tree-get for structured values.

children.description: Child nodes to create or upsert in the same call.

tree.description: Canonical node payload using the tree-get shape: name, className, properties, and optional children. Reserved property names inside properties are ignored with warnings.

tools.name: databaseobject-tree-get
tools.title: Read a canonical database object tree
tools.description: Returns a canonical subtree rooted at an existing QName. Tune depth, property mode, and limit to keep responses small; use the cursor to continue long traversals.

childrenDepth.description: Descendant levels to include. 0 returns only the target; default 1; max 20.

properties.description: Allowed values: none, changed, all. changed keeps only properties that differ from defaults.

limit.description: Maximum nodes returned per call. 1 to 5000; default 200.

_nextCursor.description: Opaque cursor from a previous response. Internal pagination token.

tools.name: log-view
tools.title: Read engine or Studio logs
tools.description: Queries LogManager with text, level, category, requestable, and date filters. Keep limits modest; use raw filter only when the simpler fields are not enough.

filter.description: Raw LogManager filter expression. Use only when the simpler filters are not enough.

text.description: Full-text filter applied to message and extra fields.

level.description: Log level such as trace, debug, info, warn, error, or fatal.

startDate.description: Epoch millis or ISO date. Inclusive lower bound.

endDate.description: Epoch millis or ISO date. Inclusive upper bound.

limit.description: Maximum log lines returned. 1 to 500; default 100.

timeoutMs.description: Max wait time per fetch cycle in milliseconds. 0 disables waiting.

fetchSize.description: Internal LogManager page size per fetch cycle. Increase only for large scans.

tools.name: marketplace-import
tools.title: Import a marketplace project
tools.description: Imports a marketplace project into the workspace and wires the reference for the target project. Starter templates may require a new local project name.

importedProjectName.description: New local project name. Required when the marketplace entry is a starter template.

tools.name: marketplace-list
tools.title: Search marketplace libraries
tools.description: Lists marketplace entries and highlights workspace or reference status. Filter with search or topics before scanning many pages.

search.description: Search text sent to the marketplace catalog.

topics.description: Optional topic filter. Accepts a single topic or an array of topic names.

limit.description: Maximum entries returned in the final result page. 1 to 200; default 20.

maxPages.description: Maximum upstream pages scanned before returning. 1 to 100; default 20.

tools.name: mobile-builder-open
tools.title: Start or reconnect to the NGX mobile builder
tools.description: Ensures the NGX builder is running and returns the detected live-reload URL plus readiness diagnostics. Use forceRestart only when the current builder is stuck or on the wrong state.

timeoutSec.description: Seconds to wait for a live-reload URL. Default 90; max 600.

logsLimit.description: Maximum builder log lines returned for diagnostics. Default 40; max 200.

forceRestart.description: Set true to restart an already running builder before waiting for readiness.

tools.name: palette-describe
tools.title: Describe a palette entry
tools.description: Returns creation hints, property metadata, and optional template details for one palette class. Use className from palette-list output.

className.description: Palette className from palette-list. NGX dynamic entries keep the #logicalId suffix.

verbose.description: Set true to include the creation template and detailed property hints.

tools.name: palette-list
tools.title: List creatable palette entries
tools.description: Returns palette items that can be created under a target parent, using Studio-compatible rules for built-in, shared, and NGX dynamic entries.

target.description: Parent QName. Append :FolderType only when you need a specific logical folder view.

includeBuiltIn.description: Default true. Set false to hide built-in entries.

includeShared.description: Default true. Set false to hide shared library entries.

filter.description: Case-insensitive filter on category and item names.

limit.description: Maximum items returned. Leave empty or 0 for no limit.

tools.name: project-js-get
tools.title: Read a project helper script
tools.description: Loads one file from the project's js/ directory. Use it to inspect helper code or schema override files before patching them.

filename.description: Path relative to js/. Do not prefix with js/.

tools.name: project-js-set
tools.title: Write a project helper script
tools.description: Creates or replaces one file under the project's js/ directory. Send the complete file content; partial patches are not supported.

filename.description: Path relative to js/. Do not prefix with js/.

content.description: Full file content to write. Replaces the existing file when it already exists.

tools.name: project-list
tools.title: List loaded Convertigo projects
tools.description: Returns loaded projects with basic metadata for admin or discovery flows. Use filter before raising the limit.

filter.description: Case-insensitive filter on project name and comment.

limit.description: Maximum projects returned per call. 1 to 100; default 10.

tools.name: project-reload
tools.title: Reload a project from disk
tools.description: Reloads one project and discards unsaved in-memory changes. Use only when you explicitly want disk state to win.

project.description: Project technical name. Omit only when the current context project is unambiguous.

tools.name: project-save
tools.title: Save a project to disk
tools.description: Exports one project from engine memory to disk. Use it after grouped mutations when autoSave was disabled.

project.description: Project technical name. Omit only when the current context project is unambiguous.

tools.name: rag-query
tools.title: Query the Convertigo knowledge base
tools.description: Fallback helper for features, setup, APIs, and troubleshooting. It is slower than local guides, so prefer documented workflows when you already have them.

question.description: Question sent to the Convertigo knowledge base.

history.description: Optional prior conversation turns, usually serialized as JSON.

prompt.description: Optional extra guidance for answer style or scope.

stream.description: Set true only if the caller can handle streamed behavior.

tools.name: requestable-execute
tools.title: Run a sequence or transaction
tools.description: Executes a requestable and returns its payload. Pass variables as an object or JSON string; enable includeLogs only for debugging, and use recordSchema only on transactions.

variables.description: Request variables as an object or a JSON string. Non-string values are serialized before execution.

recordSchema.description: Set true on transactions to update the response schema on disk. Ignored for sequences.

includeLogs.description: Set true to append execution logs from this call.
